threads.body: The removed declarative-config parsing and log assertions were the only users of `opentelemetry-sdk-extension-declarative-config` and `logunit-jul`, but both remain declared in `javaagent/build.gradle.kts`. Remove those now-unused test dependencies as part of this simplification.

replies.body:
Addressed in 4a71e50c1d609740bfdb35f8385ef42bd35ae4e8.

The complete JMX installer unit suite uses the declarative bridge and flat DefaultConfigProperties fixtures, not SDK declarative-config parsing or logunit. Commit 1 removes both unused suite dependencies while retaining the bridge dependency. All 9 existing JMX unit tests and the Kotlin Gradle formatting check pass with the reduced dependencies.
